name: Hotel Aroma Palace
why_pick: Cleanest budget option in central Chamba — three-star service at sub-₹3k tariffs, walking distance to Chaugan and Lakshmi Narayan complex. Book direct rather than through OTAs for the best rate.
what_to_know: Building is unromantic concrete; rooms are spotless and hot water is reliable. Ask for an upper-floor room facing the valley.
best_for: Couples and small families on a budget who want town walkability over scenic isolation
address_or_landmark: Chowgan Mohalla, Near Pink Palace, Chamba 176310, Himachal Pradesh
